headline: Koryx Copper Sets 2028 Construction Start for Haib Copper Mine in Namibia
summary: Koryx Copper announced that construction for the Haib southern copper mining project in Namibia is scheduled to commence in early 2028.
why: New copper mining developments are essential for meeting the anticipated long-term demand surge driven by electrification and green energy technologies.

impacts.name: Koryx Copper
impacts.why: Advancing mine construction milestones supports long-term resource production potential.
